gui.standandhold.tip.over_capacity: Above capacity: supplies are retained. Imports and generation wait for room; export and normal spending remain available.
gui.standandhold.tip.level_storage: Levelled Command Post capacity. The normal upgrade pays local costs; added room starts empty. Generation rate is unchanged.
gui.standandhold.tip.flat_storage: Flat server capacity: local levels do not change supply storage. Existing supplies are retained when limits fall; export remains available.
gui.standandhold.tip.duty_guard: Retain the existing home/wander behaviour. No recruitment, cost or teleport.
gui.standandhold.tip.duty_patrol: Two local waypoints for assigned defenders. A verified Level-2 yard has one reserved watch position; blocked paths wait rather than load chunks.
message.standandhold.growth_complete: Outpost expanded. Buildings, storage and defender limits unchanged.
gui.standandhold.growth_ground: Opens old walls; reuses an existing apron.
gui.standandhold.growth_preserved: No extra cost, refill or defender slots.
gui.standandhold.tip.expand: Expand this checkpoint once after local level 2. Rechecks terrain now; replaces 88 ground cells. No typed token needed.
gui.standandhold.tip.growth_manual: Manual: expand only when you choose. Stops automatic attempts without undoing buildings.
gui.standandhold.tip.growth_automatic: Automatic: expand once after local level 2. No spending or level changes. Obstructions pause growth until an explicit retry.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.0: No supported checkpoint layout. Buildings still work.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.4: Expanded. No automatic repair or refill.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.5: Paused: terrain or building checks failed.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.6: Paused: entities obstruct the expansion area.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.7: Paused: interrupted operation needs admin review.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.8: Growth unavailable: saved data needs review.
tooltip.standandhold.player_targets: Player hits can hurt any mob, including human units
tooltip.standandhold.player_equipment_fr: Players can use found gear at any stage
gui.standandhold.deployment.0: Slots open; spawn checks still apply
gui.standandhold.deployment.2: Dormant Main Base; stage gate not reached
gui.standandhold.deployment.3: No unit unlocked at this human stage
gui.standandhold.deployment.4: Post full; assigned units reserve slots
message.standandhold.main_base_dormant: Main Base command dormant: requires human stage %s. Lab/crate remain usable.
gui.standandhold.tip.import: Import %s global supplies into this building.
gui.standandhold.tip.export: Export %s local supplies to the global bank.
gui.standandhold.tip.store: Store up to %s carried tissue samples.
gui.standandhold.tip.take: Take up to %s stored tissue samples.
gui.standandhold.tip.start_research: Start the selected research. Costs are spent only at completion.
gui.standandhold.tip.pause_research: Pause without losing saved work or storage.
gui.standandhold.tip.next_research: Select another target without starting it; selection resets local work.
gui.standandhold.tip.pause: Clear the selected target and reset local work.
gui.standandhold.tip.upgrade: Attempt the next level using the displayed requirements.
message.standandhold.equipment_locked: Equipment locked: requires human stage %s and research %s. Data must also be available.
tooltip.standandhold.friendly_safe: Players and allied teams are protected.
gui.standandhold.tip.preview_deck: Read-only check of the Level-3 upper deck and stairs. Reports space/receipt blockers in chat. Does not build, charge, start work or change Automatic mode.
gui.standandhold.deck_requires_level: Yard complete. Upper-deck preview needs local level 3.
gui.standandhold.deck_preview_only: Upper deck: preview only. Placement not enabled.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.9: Yard complete. Upper deck requires local level 3.
gui.standandhold.deck_retained: Keeps buildings, storage and west watch
gui.standandhold.deck_kept: Level drops never demolish this layout
gui.standandhold.tip.tab_orders: The current world-shared order, what blocks it and how to fix it.
gui.standandhold.order.title: Order: %s
gui.standandhold.order.state.1: Waiting: an operator starts this order
gui.standandhold.order.state.2: All orders in the loaded catalog are complete.
gui.standandhold.order.state.3: Unavailable: orders or save data changed. Close and reopen.
gui.standandhold.order.state.4: No order available yet. Operators: /standandhold mission list
gui.standandhold.order.samples: Carry %s Tissue Samples at once (you carry %s). Undead you kill can drop them.
gui.standandhold.order.post: Find a checkpoint's Command Post, or craft one from the recipe book.
gui.standandhold.order.stockpile: Global supplies %s / %s. Supplies inside buildings don't count: Export %s here (holds %s).
gui.standandhold.order.research: At a Research Lab: select %s, Import %s supplies, then Start. No Lab? Craft one.
gui.standandhold.order.stage: Human points %s / %s. Your kills and loaded Command Posts add points.
gui.standandhold.order.defence: Defeat %s raid attackers at your posts (%s so far).
gui.standandhold.order.main_base: Find a Main Base and open its command post.
gui.standandhold.order.shared: Orders are shared by everyone in this world.
message.standandhold.post_too_close: Too close to another Command Post (%s blocks away). Posts need %s blocks between them: use the existing post or build further away.
